Title: Randomized Controlled Trial of a Brief Problem-Orientation Intervention for Suicidal Ideation
Author: Kathleen Kara Fitzpatrick; Tracy K. Witte; Norman B. Schmidt
Comment: The paper reports only total posttest n=110, not arm-specific counts. Because this was randomized and the synthesis contract explicitly permits equal allocation when arm sizes are absent, n=55 per arm was imputed. M_diff was calculated as group_2 (treatment) minus group_1 (control): 10.40 − 10.68 = −0.28. SE_diff was calculated from the reported SDs and imputed arm sizes. Hedges g was calculated from the reported posttest means/SDs and imputed n=55 per arm, then sign-oriented so positive favors the intervention because lower BSS scores are better; g ≈ +0.043. The paper did not report Hedges g. The Wald Z=2.17 and p<.05 are for the longitudinal group-slope difference, not a test confined to the immediate posttest contrast. p_value is entered as 0.05 to represent the reported threshold p<.05, not an exact p-value.
Design Type: Randomized controlled trial with repeated measurements and latent growth curve analysis
